outgoing.name: Autumn
outgoing.excerpt: The first of these privately minted tokens appeared in the autumn of 1862, in Cincinnati, Ohio.

outgoing.name: Copper
outgoing.excerpt: Civil war tokens were minted using a variety of materials, copper being a common choice (often actually bronze).

outgoing.name: Nickel
outgoing.excerpt: Other materials used for minting were nickel, tin, German silver, white metal, and silver.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: Civil War tokens are token coins that were privately minted and distributed in the United States between 1862 and 1864.
